title: Comrades Marathon FAQs — Qualification and Entry
claims: Qualifying races must be at least 42.2 km and meet CMA technical and verification standards; only official published results are accepted, and GPS, Strava or watch splits are not accepted.
The marathon qualifying limit is 4:59:59; the minimum age on qualification day is 20.
The qualification window for the 2027 race runs from 15 June 2026 to 3 May 2027, and entrants must also complete the medical questionnaire.
